ps.brief: Puzzle 1, Dragon: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: Checks first: always scan for a check before anything else.

ps.brief: Puzzle 2, Dragon: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: On an open board the Dragon reaches checking squares from far away.

ps.brief: Puzzle 3, Dragon: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: Count the lines into the King; the Dragon needs only one.

ps.brief: Puzzle 4, Dragon: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: A check also takes away the opponent's choices.

ps.brief: Puzzle 5, Dragon: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Safe captures only: make sure nothing can take back.

ps.brief: Puzzle 6, Dragon: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: In a crowded position, check who defends the piece before grabbing it.

ps.brief: Puzzle 7, Dragon: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: A capture that loses your Dragon is not a win. Count attackers and defenders.

ps.brief: Puzzle 8, Dragon: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Look for the undefended piece; that's free material.

ps.brief: Puzzle 9, Dragon: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: Use the Dragon's special trait: that's what makes it unique.

ps.brief: Puzzle 10, Dragon: Give check to the enemy King. White to move.
ps.lesson: The Dragon's trait lets it do what ordinary pieces can't.

ps.brief: Puzzle 11, Dragon: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Special moves create surprise; the opponent rarely sees them coming.

ps.brief: Puzzle 12, Dragon: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Remember the Dragon's trait in every position, not just the opening.

ps.brief: Puzzle 13, Dragon: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Fork: one move, two targets. The Dragon hits the King and a valuable piece at once.

ps.brief: Puzzle 14, Dragon: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: When the King is in check it must escape, so the second target falls.

ps.brief: Puzzle 15, Dragon: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Double attacks win material even against careful defence.

ps.brief: Puzzle 16, Dragon: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Look for a square that attacks two things at once.

ps.brief: Puzzle 17, Dragon: Capture the enemy King in 2 moves. White to move.
ps.lesson: Take the King in two: first remove every escape square, then strike.

ps.brief: Puzzle 18, Dragon: Capture the enemy King in 2 moves. White to move.
ps.lesson: Pieces in front of their own King often become a trap.

ps.brief: Puzzle 19, Dragon: Capture the enemy King in 3 moves. White to move.
ps.lesson: Three moves deep: plan backwards from the final capture.

ps.brief: Puzzle 20, Dragon: Win material. White to move.
ps.lesson: Forcing moves first, captures last.
